description: UK public sector tenders open for bids, or contract awards with the winning suppliers (Companies House number, email, phone), from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder. Filter by keyword, CPV code, region and value. Up to 100 notices from the last 30 days, refreshed daily. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

buyer.description: Buyer name contains, e.g. NHS or Council

days.description: Published in the last N days (default 30)

exclude.description: Comma-separated words or phrases to exclude

keywords.description: Comma-separated words or phrases; any must appear (whole words)

mode.description: tenders = open for bids; awards = contracts awarded, with winners

regions.description: Comma-separated: North East, North West, Yorkshire and the Humber, East Midlands, West Midlands, East of England, London, South East, South West, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland

name: tenders
title: tenders
